description: Scrape specific Reddit URLs: post permalinks (optionally with the full comment thread), user profile URLs (/user/<name>/ returns the user's posts and comments), subreddit listing URLs (/r/<name>/new/, /r/<name>/top/?t=week) or Reddit search-result page URLs. Returns structured JSON rows with a dataType of post, comment, user or community.

includeCommentThreads.description: For post URLs, return the comments too

name: scrape_reddit_urls
title: Scrape Reddit URLs
